metadata.product_name: ZeroFizz Sugar-Free Carbonated Beverage - Jobs to be Done
metadata.objective: Understand what jobs health-conscious adults 18-35 are trying to accomplish when they reach for a sugar-free carbonated beverage — functional jobs (power through the 2pm desk slump without another coffee, substitute for a beer at a rooftop bar, scratch the soda craving without a calorie hit), emotional jobs (feel indulgent without guilt, feel alert without jittery, feel like the kind of person who reads labels), and social jobs (have an adult-coded drink in hand while friends are doing Dry January, signal wellness alignment without preaching). Probe the pains driving switching — sweetener aftertaste fatigue, a TikTok creator calling out an ingredient, price creep, availability drops at their usual grocery. Elicit desired outcomes — clean energy, recognizable short-label ingredients, a flavor that doesn't get boring. Treat Coke Zero, Celsius, LaCroix, and Olipop as category alternatives respondents are hiring against.

turns.question: Think back to the last time you grabbed a sugar-free or zero-sugar drink — maybe in the last week or two — can you walk me through what was going on that day and what made you reach for that particular drink in that moment?
turns.response: Honestly I think it was like... I was at work and just needed something to drink that wouldn't make me crash later. I usually go for coffee but that day I'd already had a couple and didn't want more caffeine, so I grabbed whatever was in the fridge. Pretty much just came down to not wanting the sugar crash, that's the main thing for me.

turns.question: Why does staying steady like that through your workday matter to you?
turns.response: I guess it's just nice not to crash, you know? Like I'll have an energy dip around 3pm and if I'm drinking something with actual sugar I'm wired for a bit then just... done. With this stuff I don't get that rollercoaster feeling so I can actually focus on what I'm doing instead of thinking about when I'm gonna need another coffee.
